title: Jay Stratton's three-star slide shown to Congress

tellings.quote: Jay Stratton took this slide of three stars and presented it to people in Congress.

plain: A well-known UFO skeptic, Mick West, says that Jay Stratton, a government official who worked on the military's study of unexplained sightings, took a slide showing three stars and presented it to people in the US Congress, around 2019 to 2021. West tells it to suggest that what lawmakers were shown as something mysterious may have been ordinary stars.
